facts.fact: The Prime Minister gave instructions that the two new datacentres become the single base for hosting public platforms, under the ministry's 'Zero donnee hebergee a l'exterieur' chantier.
facts.system: Zero donnee hebergee a l'exterieur chantier

facts.fact: Two modular government datacentres (about 3,000 TB, about 28,800 CPU cores) inaugurated on 23 January 2026 as the base of the government cloud that public bodies are to use.
